scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 NSG 操作场景：创建网络安全组 → 添加规则 → 列出规则 → 关联子网 → 删除
commands: az network nsg create --name test-nsg --resource-group test-rg --location eastus
az network nsg rule create --name allow-443 --nsg-name test-nsg --resource-group test-rg --priority 100 --access Allow --protocol Tcp --destination-port-range 443
az network nsg rule list --nsg-name test-nsg --resource-group test-rg
az network vnet subnet update --name test-subnet --vnet-name test-vnet --resource-group test-rg --network-security-group test-nsg
az network nsg delete --name test-nsg --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：NSG 创建成功但规则创建失败
commands: az network nsg create --name fail-nsg --resource-group test-rg --location eastus
az network nsg rule create --name allow-443 --nsg-name fail-nsg --resource-group test-rg --priority 100 --access Allow --protocol Tcp --destination-port-range 443

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：NSG 不存在
commands: az network nsg show --name nonexistent-nsg --resource-group test-rg
